name: Reports opens the tabbed report catalog on Pre Defined Reports
description:
Objective: Reports opens the tabbed report catalog on Pre Defined Reports.
Preconditions: Open Reporting readonly with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Reporting readonly.
2. Reports opens the tabbed report catalog on Pre Defined Reports.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The behavior named in the scenario is observed and its assertions pass.
